scope: The 8 admitted X509_VERIFY_POLICY production obligation(s) in src/x509/v3_crld.rs that the enumerated SSH closure reports as reachable but without an owning boundary receipt are enumerated here for ownership only, at their census coordinates, with a hazard read from each function. This receipt claims no discharge, no contract and no new reachability finding.
non_claims: This receipt does not discharge any site, and no site may be treated as discharged on its authority.
This receipt does not contract any site; the hazard notes are enumeration notes, not established contracts.
This receipt does not assert reachability; reachability is taken from the enumerated closure and is not re-established here.

boundaries.hazard: Raw CONF_VALUE stack and X509V3_CTX are dereferenced; sections and GENERAL_NAME values are built into a new distribution-point stack with partial cleanup on failure.
Raw ISSUING_DIST_POINT is dereferenced; distpoint, onlysomereasons and the boolean flags are printed, with the reasons bit string forwarded to print_reasons.
Raw CONF_VALUE stack and X509V3_CTX are parsed into a new ISSUING_DIST_POINT; name keys select fields, and a failed entry leaves cleanup to the function's error path.
Raw STACK_OF(DIST_POINT) is iterated; each point's distpoint, reasons and CRLissuer are forwarded to raw printers when non-NULL.
Raw ASN1_GENERALIZEDTIME pointer is cast and passed to ASN1_GENERALIZEDTIME_print; the date pointer's liveness is a caller obligation.
Raw ASN1_OBJECT pointer is cast and passed to i2a_ASN1_OBJECT; the object pointer's liveness is a caller obligation.
Raw CONF_VALUE stack and X509V3_CTX are parsed into an OSSL_AA_DIST_POINT; the first stack element is read at index 0 and section/name paths take ownership of built values.
Raw OSSL_AA_DIST_POINT is dereferenced; distpoint, reasons and the boolean flags are printed, forwarding the reasons bit string to print_reasons.
